currentReview.scope: Original 21-part/35-placement istanbulSapphireStudy.encodeAssembly remains unchanged and reconstitutes the 79531556-byte source master (1547192 expanded /947096 stored triangles). Reviewed source and browser closeup reconstruct the same double-shell tower at medium-fi with all sixteen three-storey garden groups, two balcony slabs, transparent weather shell, recessed inner glazing, wood gallery edges, faceted planted beds, three social louvre groups, opaque south blade, two observation floors and 261 m mast. Galleries and plants now taper together with the outer skin, preventing protrusion from the old untapered repeated interiors. Continuous shared grids replace independent per-pane seal/frame boxes; wood grain replaces dense edge battens; faceted crowns replace tens of thousands of individual leaves. Explicit glass skins and interior volumes remain in close/street; district/skyline use opaque surfaces and omit interior garden geometry. Street reduces 30 long-face bays to six, 12 end bays to three, uses a broad inner pane, omits rail posts and plant trunks, and reduces beds/canopy ribs. Close retains the long-face two-light rhythm, single-light end glazing, seven-bay inner glazing, coarse handrail posts and faceted foliage. Detailed source master remains available from its original recipe, not installed by the viewer. Retail footprint corrected to fresh exact-QID mall ring, independent from preserved tower rectangle; glass roof overhang and curve endpoints/width are approximate. Eight east entrance leaves are an illustrative existing reconstruction, not a verified count; interiors have generic slabs/cores/galleries, no claimed apartment or retail fitout. 55 registry floors, 64 mapped levels and 48 residential plus lower/observation facade rows are separate; working 24.3/230.7/239.35/242.2 m levels, .8/.65 m taper, 4.3 m intervals, plant distribution and 62 m roof width are photographic/section reconstructions, not dimensioned surveys. Three canonical graphs provide concrete, stainless and wood; opaque/42 percent clear glass and foliage yield six near groups with one BLEND group and no embedded images. Underground car parks, neighboring towers, metro and wider site excluded. Physical phone/laptop and dense-city timings remain pending.
